crossRefs.note: Let him give his cheek to him who strikes him. Let him be filled full of reproach.
Now you shall gather yourself in troops, daughter of troops. He has laid siege against us. They will strike the judge…
But I tell you, don’t resist him who is evil; but whoever strikes you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also.
Then they spat in his face and beat him with their fists, and some slapped him,
Then he released to them Barabbas, but Jesus he flogged and delivered to be crucified.
Some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to beat him with fists, and to tell him, “Prophesy!” The officers…
They struck his head with a reed, and spat on him, and bowing their knees, did homage to him.
The men who held Jesus mocked him and beat him.
Having blindfolded him, they struck him on the face and asked him, “Prophesy! Who is the one who struck you?”
When he had said this, one of the officers standing by slapped Jesus with his hand, saying, “Do you answer the high…
looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross…

translations.web: I gave my back to those who beat me, and my cheeks to those who plucked off the hair. I didn’t hide my face from shame and spitting.
translations.bsb: I offered My back to those who struck Me, and My cheeks to those who tore out My beard. I did not hide My face from scorn and spittle.
translations.kjv: I gave my back to the smiters, and my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair: I hid not my face from shame and spitting.
translations.asv: I gave my back to the smiters, and my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair; I hid not my face from shame and spitting.
